description: Source code for Android's FLAC audio extractor, including classes for parsing FLAC streams, extracting metadata, and interfacing with media buffers.

classes.name: FLACSource
classes.description: MediaTrackHelper subclass that provides FLAC stream data to the media framework.

classes.name: FLACParser
classes.description: Handles parsing of FLAC streams, including metadata extraction and PCM data decoding.

methods.name: shouldExtractorOutputFloat
methods.description: Determines if the extractor should output float PCM data based on bits per sample and calling UID.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the FLAC parser, sets up libFLAC stream decoder, and parses metadata.

methods.name: readBuffer
methods.description: Reads and decodes a buffer of PCM data from the FLAC stream, with optional seeking.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the format metadata for the FLAC track.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the FLAC source, allocating buffers.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the FLAC source, releasing buffers.

methods.name: getTrackMetaData
methods.description: Provides track-specific metadata including PCM encoding.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads PCM data buffer, handling seek if requested.
